name: tasks.create
description: Create an encrypted task in an owned chain. A live chain publishes and may dispatch immediately; a draft chain retains drafts. To offload, select a durable assignee_agent_id and explicit bridge_id after configuring its fleet placement. Reuse request_id with identical arguments on retries.

name: tasks.update
description: Patch an owned task through native rules. Supply expected_revision from tasks.get and a stable request_id. Leased tasks retain native edit restrictions; omitted fields stay unchanged. Task-read permission is needed to obtain revisions.

name: tasks.control
description: Use a native task action with expected_revision from tasks.get and stable request_id. Approval/review and external leases are unavailable. Hold, cancel and answer require a reason. Workflow tasks retain engine restrictions.

name: chains.configure
description: Configure an owned chain using configuration_revision from chains.get as expected_revision. Action fleet pins an owned durable agent to an explicit owned online bridge and supported provider/model; action publish publishes the chain through native validation. Reuse request_id for retries. Can dispatch waiting work.

name: tasks.list
description: List a page of your chain tasks, including readable goals and acceptance criteria. Requires task-read permission.

name: tasks.get
description: Read an owned task, its goal, acceptance, placement, dependencies, current review verdicts and comments.

name: tasks.comment
description: Add an encrypted comment to an owned published task. Supply a stable request_id and reuse it with exactly the same task_id and body on retries. This operation does not send messages or wake an agent.

name: chains.list
description: List your Heimdall task chains in readable form.

name: chains.get
description: Read an owned chain, task/review status and comments.

name: chains.create
description: Create an encrypted draft chain as the connected user. Does not assign or launch an agent. Do not automatically retry an ambiguous result.

name: events.wait
description: Wait for an owner change hint, then return a fresh owned-chain snapshot. Client-driven polling only: keep calling while actively monitoring with a stopping condition and budget. No replay or background wake guarantee.
